 November Social Security payments modified. Here are the new dates
 Tamara Walker, Asbury Park Press 2026년 10월 27일 화 오후 1:40 UTC 0 The Social Security Administration has made changes to two payment dates for the month of November.
 These changes are for Supplemental Security Income (SSI) and Social Security payments and calls for benefits being distributed early because of the calendar days and a holiday schedule.
 According to the agency, SSI payments will be distributed this Friday, Oct. 30 and beneficiaries with birth dates that fall (1st through 10th) of the month will receive their payment on Tuesday Nov. 10, instead of Wednesday, Nov. 11.
 Here's why these payment schedules have changed:
 Advertisement
 October SSI payment date
 Checks will be delivered on Friday, Oct. 30, instead of the regular scheduled date because Nov. 1 falls on a Sunday.
 Social Security November payment date change
 Beneficiaries of Social Security will receive their checks one day early due to Wednesday, Nov. 11 being a federal holiday — Veterans Day.
 Social Security payment date: November 2026
 Here are the payment dates for Social Security checks in November, according to the agency. 
 Tuesday, Nov. 10, for Social Security beneficiaries with birth dates between 1-10.
 Wednesday, Nov. 18, for Social Security beneficiaries with birth dates between 11-20.
 Wednesday, Nov. 25, for Social Security beneficiaries with birth dates between 21-31.
